ablation_policy: Single-factor removals only, preregistered per hypothesis; ablations are diagnostic, never winners.
cost_contract: 11F ladder A/B/C/D (0 | 0.05%+2bp | 0.059%+5bp | 2xC), funding=0, certified accounting; net=gross-fees-slippage.
datasets: D1+D2 universe (BTC/ETH 1m, 7001 bars/symbol, contaminated lineage disclosed); D3 sealed; no new data.
entry_model: NEXT_BAR_OPEN family-wide (signal bar i -> market fill bar i+1 open); retest confirmations enter next open (no limit-fill assumptions).
execution_channel: certified NEXT_BAR_OPEN market-fill path with pre-stamped frozen-signal triggers; declared-mode gate via research-only patch (restored).
fibonacci_policy: Confluence only; frozen ratios 0.382/0.500/0.618/0.786/1.272/1.618; no standalone fib hypothesis; no custom ratios.
orderflow_policy: No REAL order-flow hypotheses (historically unavailable). PROXY only when explicitly labeled; no silent substitution.
risk_contract: balance 2000, risk/trade 0.01, leverage 10x, allocation cap 500; signals only, risk/execution separate.
scoring_policy: No scores, weights, ranks, or confidence thresholds. Boolean/structured event conditions only. No ML.
wf_contract: expanding-origin (train_start=0 always), train>=2000/test 1000/purge 150/embargo 25/step 1000/4 folds; cold-start engines; train-only fits.
